items.text: Heyho everyone,
we have just rolled out a new maintenance patch for Woodo. This update focuses on quality-of-life improvements, general polish, and bug fixes based on your recent feedback and bug reports!

Key adjustments in this patch include a new setting to disable controller vibration, improved object visibility and hint cameras in select levels, and fixes for gamepad panning and physics behavior at lower framerates.
Tiny Monks Tales & Daedalic Entertainment
Added option to disable vibration in settings
Fixed hints in Dusty Den
Fixed hints in Lake (inside the boat)
Fixed the pan function on the gamepad (in some cases)
Fixed some texts in certain languages
Fixed how gravity objects behave at low FPS
Added highlights to levitating objects when they appear (to make them more visible) and to fish inside the boat
Added localized tooltips for the walkie-talkie
Added a monk icon to the HUD to make it clearer on which levels the monk is available for the achievement
Simplified the option to skip the hint tutorial
Fixed several minor bugs

releases.displayName: The demo update based on your feedback!

items.text: Long time no see, right?
Over the past month, we’ve been working on a big demo update based on your survey feedback. Thank you so much for your thoughtful responses and warm words. 🦊🧡🐸

notes.title: Here’s what’s new in the demo

items.text: Camera panning
Zooming in on objects
Improved controls
Hint system
Expanded settings
New tutorial
Progress bar
One of the most requested features is now in the demo! 🥳
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/588a9a63230444036e66c0b672cd0b0e88f274a2.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/b6ba8118a745e2bde24f667b8aeedcf12370ca9e.png"]

You can pan when zoomed in on objects. It’s disabled in the default camera view (the view when you see the whole diorama and rotate around it), so you won’t accidentally discover our low-poly background secrets and imperfections. 🤭
You can now click almost anywhere to zoom in. There are no more predefined focus points. Finally, full freedom to explore every little detail. Helpful for gameplay… and perfect for photo mode. ✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/8d46b6c2790811bbffd1426690d47c094a53cdee.png"]
Some of you told us your wrists hurt when playing with a mouse, so we made it more comfortable.
Now you can choose: drag and drop pieces, or click once to attach a piece to your cursor. Yes, it is so intuitive!
Since you no longer need to hold the mouse button, you can now rotate the scene while holding a piece. Gamepad users could already do this—now mouse users can too. 🥳
You can even zoom in (by clicking the object with the right button) while holding a piece!
Panning while holding a piece isn’t possible yet… but hopefully in the full release.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/f6021a7aa1efbd08db0478b3e1f7a2af349ce3d4.gif"]
Most of you don’t use hints because, I know, you enjoy the challenge. But we believe that simply knowing a hint is available makes the experience more relaxed. No pressure at all.
You can pick any (!) object in the Object Panel and see where it belongs. How cool is that! 😃
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/deb75cf31187659ae15acd27fdbe94b12418c967.gif"]

notes.title: The hint works in two steps

items.text: First, it moves you toward the right area
Then, it highlights the exact spot
This gives you a chance to figure things out yourself before the game becomes more direct.
You can also adjust how strong the highlighting is in the settings. Turn it off completely to see only the area, or turn it on to see the exact place immediately.
Adaptive Assistance
When it’s ON, the easiest pieces appear first in the Object Panel. These are usually bigger or have clearer shapes. As you place more pieces, the puzzle naturally becomes easier.
By default, the game watches your pace and decides whether assistance should be active.
You can turn it off at any time.
Magnetism
This controls the snap distance. Some of you asked to reduce it or remove it completely, so now you can adjust it yourself.
Many of you said the game feels intuitive, but we still believe a small tutorial in Foxy’s notebook can help you feel more confident and not get lost.
It was such a pleasure to create these little pages. I really love how they turned out. Do you? 😄
Last but not least, we added a progress bar so you always know how many pieces are still ahead of you.
We got inspired by real-life Lego sets. 🤭
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/91f8d8c12437842d0be308ea08332ba014ef926c.png"]
If you’ve read this far, you’re definitely a Woodo fan, and we appreciate it so, so much! 💖
And if you’re new here, here are a few simple things you can do:
• Play the demo
• Let us know your thoughts
• Leave a comment on the demo page. We read them all
• Share the demo with friends. Maybe they’ll love it too
Stay safe and have a cozy day!
Julia: Tiny Monks Tales
Hi, you most dearest of followers! 🤗💛
We’ve received more than 4,200 responses, and that’s huge! We’re truly grateful!

notes.title: Just see how many of you like the game

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44574529/6681accca5b3914f578af003d2dbc053980a81eb.jpg"]

Reading your warm, supportive, and funny thoughts has been pure joy. Whenever I need to cheer myself up, I go back to the question, “What do you like about Woodo?” and it honestly feels like therapy. 🤭
We carefully read everything you wrote and already made a plan for future updates. ✍️
Over the past days, we released a few patches to fix the most obvious issues, and now we’re preparing bigger improvements based on your feedback.

notes.title: Here are the main things we’re going to work on

items.text: Improving controls
Adding Foxy’s diary, where players (especially non-native English speakers) will be able to reread the narrator’s lines without worrying they missed something during gameplay
Expanding localization into some more languages
We are also considering your other ideas and working on the rest of the game, of course!
If you enjoy playing and want to support us, you can wishlist the game or leave a review on Steam - it has a huge effect! 😌
See you,
💌 Your Tiny Monks Tales team
